events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Andrei Vasilevskiy made 20 saves for his first shutout of the season, Brandon Hagel had two goals and an assist and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vasilevskiy makes 20 saves, Hagel has 2 goals and an assist in Lightning's 3-0 win over Flyers

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Nico Hischier, Timo Meier and Connor Brown had a goal and an assist each and the New Jersey Devils beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-3 on Monday night in a matchup of two of the top four teams in the Eastern Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devils snap losing streak with 4-3 win over Red Wings

events.name: St. Louis Blues at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Alexis Lafreniere scored the go-ahead goal early in the third period and Igor Shesterkin made 19 saves as the New York Rangers snapped a four-game skid with a 3-2 win over the St. Louis Blues on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lafreniere scores go-ahead goal and Rangers snap 4-game skid with 3-2 win over Blues

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Jakob Chychrun scored twice and the Washington Capitals beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chychrun scores twice to lift Capitals over Blue Jackets 5-1

headlines.description: — A.J. Greer scored twice and added an assist, Sam Reinhart and Carter Verhaeghe had a goal and two assists apiece, and the Florida Panthers beat the Nashville Predators 8-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greer's two goals, assist lead Panthers over reeling Predators 8-3

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley scored four straight goals and had an assist and the Utah Mammoth beat the Vegas Golden Knights 5-1 on Monday night to avenge a home loss four days earlier.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooley scores 4 straight goals in 5-point night in Mammoth's 5-1 win over Golden Knights

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Brandt Clarke scored a power-play goal with 6:10 to play to lift the Los Angeles Kings to a 2-1 win over the Ottawa Senators on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clarke's power-play goal ends Kings' 3-game losing streak
